purpose: Record 2026-06-28 session consolidation as A|E induction candidates and proof obligations without promoting them into the core framework.

governance_position.rule: All items in this patch are induction candidates only.
governance_position.non_promotion_clause: No candidate in this patch may be treated as a core primitive, theorem, or established ontology without separate reduction, consistency, and induction success.
